rows.label: THL's own spending on running the Open Wing Alliance (staff, trainings, Fair and Fowl), 2025
rows.explainer: Our judgment, read by charityevals' THL models so the alliance's running is one number: THL's annual report (p. 17: Global Programs $5,204,000 with the THL UK grant; Education & Mobilization $4,664,000; US Public Policy & Corporate Engagement $2,498,000; OWA & APA Grants $1,991,000) leaves $3.05 million of global programmes after the THL UK grant, which ACE's global accountability block ($1.65 million in 2025 prices) and the alliance's running fill: about $1.5 million. ACE treats the Open Wing Alliance's coordination as paths of its own, outside cage-free accountability, so it is in THL's other programmes: the alliance's team, four regional summits, trainings (four Campaign Accelerators, 13 webinars, 19 campaign chats, 21 action parties), mentorship (27 mentees) and the Fair and Fowl report.

rows.label: Of THL's 7.5 million hens switched in 2025, those at companies the Open Wing Alliance's members pressed
rows.explainer: Our judgment. THL counts the switches at 'each food company we've partnered with or pressured' (its cost-per-hen method), which includes multinationals the Alliance's members pressed abroad; those switches are credited in the Alliance's branches of the grants line, so THL's own campaigns' pool leaves them out. ACE's sheet puts THL's engaged supply chains at 113.9 million hens abroad against 135.5 million in the US, but most of the year's switches were in the US; best guess about a fifth of the 7.5 million, range 0.5 to 3.5 million.

rows.label: Of THL's 7.5 million hens switched in 2025, UK hens at companies THL UK pressed
rows.explainer: Our judgment. THL's count is of hens at the companies it and the Alliance pressed, so its UK part is the switches at THL UK's engaged companies, not the whole country's change: ACE's sheet puts those companies' supply chains at 2.55 million hens, most already compliant. The high end is the UK's whole change in 2025 (82.7% against 78.6% cage-free of about 45 million hens, Our World in Data and the British Egg Information Service). THL UK is a separate charity THL funds by a grant, so these switches are credited in the grants line (as a share of the UK's whole change).

rows.label: Of THL's 2025 Animal Policy Alliance grants, the part spent opposing federal preemption
rows.explainer: Our judgment: THL's 2025 announcement of the grants ($295K to 12 members) names no project on the EATS language, the 'Save Our Bacon' Act or the Farm Bill; only the Missouri Alliance for Animal Legislation names federal lobbying, and Humane Action Pennsylvania federal priorities. About $15,000, range $5,000-35,000; part of the one coalition pool (@farm_animal_laws.us_preemption_coalition_spend_2025).
